purpose: Traceable starter catalog from historical spaceflight capabilities to reproducible engineering references and staged lunar-base requirements.

semantics.non_implication_rule: An evidence state does not imply any later state. Historical success is not proof of Symtropy model fidelity; a simulation is not hardware qualification; a reference label is not a reproduced result.

sources.title: Moon to Mars Architecture — Components
sources.supports: NASA’s 12 sub-architectures, including autonomy/robotics, communications/PNT, habitation, ISRU, logistics, mobility, power, transportation and infrastructure.

sources.title: Moon Base Systems
sources.supports: Phased lunar-base capability development, environmental challenges, power, mobility, habitation, communications and logistics.

sources.title: Lunar Surface Technology
sources.supports: Surface power/storage, ISRU, autonomous robotics, construction/landing pads, and dust/thermal constraints; distinguishes technology development from operational base capability.

sources.title: History of Lunar Exploration
sources.supports: Lunar orbital, landing, crewed exploration and sample-handling history.

sources.title: The Space Shuttle
sources.supports: Repeated reusable orbital transportation, satellite deployment/recovery/repair, and station assembly.

sources.title: Explore NASA’s History
sources.supports: Apollo-Soyuz docking, Shuttle-Mir cooperation, and ISS assembly history.

sources.title: Environmental Control and Life Support Systems
sources.supports: Atmosphere, oxygen, ventilation, fire protection, water recovery, air revitalization and oxygen generation.

sources.title: The History of Hubble
sources.supports: Designed-for-serviceability, five on-orbit servicing missions and instrument/component replacement.

sources.title: Voyager Mission
sources.supports: Long-duration deep-space operations, autonomy, power constraints and long-delay communications.

sources.title: Mars 2020: Perseverance Rover
sources.supports: Robotic planetary landing, surface mobility, perception, sample caching and remote/autonomous rover operations.

sources.title: Ingenuity Mars Helicopter
sources.supports: First powered, controlled flight on another planet; 72 flights and operational lessons for aerial exploration.

sources.title: OSIRIS-REx Mission
sources.supports: Asteroid navigation/rendezvous, sample acquisition and return to Earth; sample delivered in September 2023.

sources.title: Planetary Defense: DART
sources.supports: Kinetic-impact spacecraft navigation and demonstrated change to an asteroid moonlet’s orbit.

sources.title: Moon-to-Mars Planetary Autonomous Construction Technology
sources.supports: Technology development for using lunar materials to make construction elements; not proof of an operational lunar construction plant.

sources.title: In-Situ Resource Utilization Overview
sources.supports: Resource characterization, accessibility, acquisition, processing and product-quality distinctions.

capabilities.name: Launch, orbital insertion, trajectory and reentry
capabilities.what_was_demonstrated: Vehicles have launched, inserted payloads into orbit, performed lunar/deep-space transfers, and returned crew or cargo to Earth in specific mission architectures.
capabilities.reproduction_target: Versioned trajectory cases with frames, epochs, propulsion assumptions and independent reference states; report position/velocity error, delta-v budget error and event timing error.
capabilities.next_action: Select a documented low-risk historical trajectory with published initial conditions and ephemerides; freeze frame/time standards before comparing integrators.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: No historical trajectory reproduction is claimed until inputs and reference outputs are frozen and independent numeric tolerances pass.

capabilities.name: Crewed lunar landing, EVA and surface sample handling
capabilities.what_was_demonstrated: Apollo missions performed crewed lunar landings, extravehicular activities and sample collection/handling.
capabilities.reproduction_target: Mission-profile and resource-accounting cases for descent/ascent, EVA timelines, consumables and sample custody, with historical missions as documented requirements—not a claim to reproduce unprovided telemetry.
capabilities.next_action: Build a separate historical mission profile/consumables fixture; keep actual guidance/control qualification outside the digital twin until reference-grade data and safety review exist.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: Historical success does not prove a new lander or autonomous lunar vehicle safe.

capabilities.name: Rendezvous, proximity operations, docking and berthing
capabilities.what_was_demonstrated: Crewed vehicles docked in orbit, modules were assembled into stations, and a servicing vehicle captured and worked on Hubble.
capabilities.reproduction_target: Relative-state estimation, approach corridors, closing-rate limits, keep-out zones, contact dynamics and abort cases with independent geometry and dynamics oracles.
capabilities.next_action: Define one 6-DoF synthetic approach/abort known-answer case and a separate Hubble-style servicing kinematics fixture.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: A contact simulation is not a flight docking or capture qualification.

capabilities.name: Reusable orbital transportation and recovery
capabilities.what_was_demonstrated: The Space Shuttle fleet repeatedly launched, operated in orbit and landed its orbiter on a runway across 135 missions.
capabilities.reproduction_target: Turnaround lifecycle and repeated mission reliability accounting across refurbishments, inspections, damage, consumables and launch/landing constraints.
capabilities.next_action: Create a lifecycle baseline whose denominator includes all flown missions and whose maintenance/refurbishment evidence is distinct from nominal flight simulation.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: Repeated historical flights do not imply that every possible reusable launch architecture is economically superior or safe.

capabilities.name: Long-duration habitation and environmental control/life support
capabilities.what_was_demonstrated: The ISS has supported long-duration crews with atmosphere management, water recovery, air revitalization, oxygen generation, ventilation and waste systems.
capabilities.reproduction_target: Subsystem mass/energy/material balances, service availability and fault/recovery campaigns with each resource flow conserved and subsystem boundaries explicit.
capabilities.next_action: Define the smallest headless habitat service contract and a separate water/air/waste mass-balance fixture; do not average ECLSS service into one score.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: A simulated closed loop does not establish human-rated life support, microbiological safety or long-duration reliability.

capabilities.name: On-orbit repair, upgrade and maintainability
capabilities.what_was_demonstrated: Hubble was designed for serviceability and received five crewed servicing missions that installed instruments and replaced/repaired components.
capabilities.reproduction_target: Repair task graphs, access envelope, tool/resource constraints, fault isolation, replacement compatibility, post-repair validation and lifecycle benefit versus replacement.
capabilities.next_action: Represent one bounded replaceable-unit task as a deterministic manipulation and maintenance campaign, including failed-tool and unavailable-part negative cases.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: Manipulation success in simulation is not evidence of EVA or autonomous servicing safety.

capabilities.name: Long-duration deep-space autonomy and delayed communication
capabilities.what_was_demonstrated: Deep-space spacecraft have operated over decades with constrained power and long communication delays, requiring onboard autonomy and ground/spacecraft coordination.
capabilities.reproduction_target: Delayed/lost/duplicated commands, clock drift, telemetry gaps, mode transitions, power decline, recovery and stale-state rejection under a versioned network/time model.
capabilities.next_action: Compose a delayed-command replay fixture with an independent event oracle and fail-closed command-state semantics.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: A synthetic link-delay scenario does not reproduce any Voyager flight segment or prove radiation-hardened onboard operation.

capabilities.name: Robotic planetary landing, surface mobility and sample operations
capabilities.what_was_demonstrated: Mars missions have landed robotic vehicles, conducted surface mobility, used perception and collected/cached samples for further investigation/return planning.
capabilities.reproduction_target: Terrain/deformation, wheel/traction, localization drift, energy, hazard detection, sampling/actuation envelope, slip and recovery using logged reference runs where available.
capabilities.next_action: Select one publicly documented rover traverse or controlled terrain benchmark; freeze terrain, pose, odometry and intervention labels.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: A Bevy terrain twin or synthetic rover drive is not validated Mars rover physics or autonomous flight behavior.

capabilities.name: Powered flight in another planet's atmosphere
capabilities.what_was_demonstrated: Ingenuity demonstrated powered, controlled flight on Mars and completed 72 flights before the mission concluded in 2024.
capabilities.reproduction_target: Atmospheric density/rotor scaling, navigation, flight envelopes, energy, gust/terrain hazard cases and landing/recovery contracts with independently sourced environment inputs.
capabilities.next_action: Use published Ingenuity flight/engineering datasets only after units, environment assumptions and data rights are reviewed.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: A rotorcraft simulation at Earth settings is not a Mars-flight reproduction.

capabilities.name: Small-body rendezvous, sample acquisition and return
capabilities.what_was_demonstrated: OSIRIS-REx rendezvoused with Bennu, acquired a surface sample and delivered it to Earth in September 2023.
capabilities.reproduction_target: Navigation, proximity approach, sampling-contact envelope, sample containment/custody, contamination controls, return trajectory and recovery timeline.
capabilities.next_action: Construct a reference/data registry for a single publicly available OSIRIS-REx sequence; do not infer sample capture from arm pose alone.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: A synthetic sampling event does not reproduce Bennu contact physics, sample integrity, or planetary-protection qualification.

capabilities.name: Kinetic-impact change to an asteroid orbit
capabilities.what_was_demonstrated: DART’s intentional impact measurably changed the orbit of Dimorphos around Didymos.
capabilities.reproduction_target: Impact geometry, momentum-transfer uncertainty, ejecta sensitivity and orbit-fitting against published before/after observations using an independent propagator.
capabilities.next_action: Use published post-impact orbit change as an external check only after input ephemerides, mass/impact assumptions and uncertainty are frozen.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: A basic impulse in a simulator is not a validated asteroid-impact model.

capabilities.name: Lunar resource characterization and in-situ resource utilization
capabilities.what_was_demonstrated: Lunar resource investigations and technology tests have advanced prospecting and oxygen-extraction concepts, including testing regolith simulants; sustained site-qualified water/oxygen production is not established by this ledger.
capabilities.reproduction_target: Evidence-bounded prospect-to-product process graph: location/form/concentration/accessibility, acquisition losses, process energy, yield, purity, residue, equipment/spares and downstream qualification.
capabilities.next_action: Extend PR #1971 only after its synthetic control/accounting semantics and exact-head Rust tests qualify; keep site evidence and simulated process yield distinct.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: Resource occurrence or a simulant test does not prove a recoverable reserve or dependable operational supply.

capabilities.name: Autonomous or remotely operated lunar-site construction
capabilities.what_was_demonstrated: NASA has run technology-development work for using lunar simulants/materials to manufacture construction elements; this is not a completed autonomous lunar construction plant.
capabilities.reproduction_target: Geology/site envelope, machine capability limits, excavation/spoil/berm/landing-pad mass, power, dust, wear, terrain stability, inspection and repair work packages.
capabilities.next_action: Connect #1803 resource chains to #1834 robot capability envelopes and the terrain model via a fixed synthetic worksite before planning a physical pilot.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: Voxel excavation or printed berm geometry alone does not establish bearing capacity, landing safety or lunar durability.

capabilities.name: Integrated sustained lunar base
capabilities.what_was_demonstrated: NASA has published a phased Moon Base architecture; integrated long-duration human lunar settlement is a target, not an achieved operational capability.
capabilities.reproduction_target: Capability dependencies across power/storage, communications/PNT, robotics/mobility, logistics, habitation/ECLSS, thermal, dust/radiation, resource production, maintenance, fault recovery and crew safety.
capabilities.next_action: Use phase gates: uncrewed site survey and power demonstration; sustained robotic operation; qualified local products; redundant utilities and recovery; only then human-rated habitat integration.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: A digital twin or set of subsystem simulations is not an autonomous Moon base.
